SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, sofa-axis camera: the caramel corduroy sofa faces the camera with the arched window and prayer flags behind it; the kitchen island is off-frame to the right. Exactly as in the start image: the man with glasses (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, ID badge on a navy lanyard, grey trousers, black leather shoes) alone in a chest-up close-up on the center cushion of the sofa, the dark arched window and plant behind him, eyes down on the phone in his hand.

FORMAT MODE
ONE single continuous locked-off shot for the entire clip: no cuts, no shot changes, no punch-in, no second angle; the framing at the last frame is identical to the first frame.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image for the entire clip: no zoom, no pan, no dolly, no reframing, the camera never follows a person. Do not flip. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0-0.3s hold: eyes on the phone. 0.3-1.8s LINE part 1: he brings the phone a little closer and peers at the screen while saying the first half. 1.8-3.3s LINE part 2: his face falls, corners of the mouth down, shoulders drop a little as he says the second half; lips move only as much as the words need. 3.3-4.0s RECOVERY: holds the sulky face, eyes still on the phone, one slow blink.

CHARACTERS
Rule: the man with glasses moves only his eyes, eyebrows and lips; head stays within a few degrees; glasses never come off; no grin.

PERFORMANCE
In character: sulky, crestfallen, quiet; minimal facial movement. No exaggerated acting, nobody looks at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. Everyone keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take; nobody else enters the frame. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The man speaks natural native Korean, low, calm and quiet, polite and unhurried, never raising his voice, the sentence ending on a soft falling tone: "다들 읽으셨는데... 아무도 답변을 안 해주셔...". Only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural, underplayed delivery: lips move only as much as the words need, the mouth never opens wide, no exaggerated expressions; visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word. Nobody else speaks.
